name: rica-developerui
description: violations detection and guidance to solve

javaAstAnalyzer.backendUrl.description: Backend server URL for the RICA engine and visualizer dashboard

javaAstAnalyzer.autoAnalyzeOnOpen.description: Automatically analyze project when workspace opens

javaAstAnalyzer.debounceDelay.description: Debounce delay in ms for file change events (edit buffer before delta analysis)

javaAstAnalyzer.enableArchitecturalCheck.description: Enable cross-file architectural rules: controller-bypass, cyclic-dependency, cross-layer-violation, entity-exposure (V401-V404)

javaAstAnalyzer.enableDesignPatternCheck.description: Enable dependency injection and layer-access pattern checks: self-instantiation, uninjected-service, uninjected-repository (V101-V109)

javaAstAnalyzer.enableBusinessLogicCheck.description: Enable business logic location checks: business-logic-in-controller, business-logic-in-resource, anemic-entity (V106, V108, V204)

javaAstAnalyzer.businessLogicThreshold.description: Score threshold for business logic detection in methods; higher = fewer warnings

javaAstAnalyzer.constructionStatementLim.description: V308: maximum construction statements allowed inside a single `new` expression before flagging leaking construction logic

javaAstAnalyzer.fatInterfaceMethodLimit.description: V309: maximum declared methods on a project interface before flagging a fat interface / ISP violation

javaAstAnalyzer.missingCommandComplexity.description: V310: minimum cyclomatic complexity for a method with multiple persistence writes to flag missing Command pattern

javaAstAnalyzer.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from analysis

javaAstAnalyzer.layerBoundaries.description: Layer boundary definitions for package-violation rule (V501). Each layer lists package patterns and allowed dependency layers.

javaAstAnalyzer.enableAiAdvisory.description: Enable the optional AI Reasoning advisory. Non-blocking: AI findings annotate deterministic violations (RICA-V000) and never delete them

javaAstAnalyzer.aiProvider.description: AI provider. 'ollama' targets an Ollama server (e.g. hosted on Google Colab); 'openai-compatible' targets any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions API

javaAstAnalyzer.aiEndpoint.description: AI provider endpoint. Set to your Colab/tunnel Ollama URL when running the model remotely

javaAstAnalyzer.aiModel.description: Model name/tag served by the configured provider (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:7b, llama3.1:8b)

javaAstAnalyzer.aiMaxTokensPerRequest.description: Maximum output tokens per AI reasoning request

javaAstAnalyzer.aiTimeoutMs.description: Request timeout in ms for AI reasoning calls; failures are logged and never block the deterministic pipeline

javaAstAnalyzer.aiMaxCandidatesPerRun.description: Maximum ambiguity candidates triaged into a single AI reasoning run

javaAstAnalyzer.aiTrigger.description: When AI reasoning triggers: 'onDemand' via the rica.aiReview command, 'onSave' after delta analysis, 'onFullScan' after full project analysis

javaAstAnalyzer.aiAuditLogEnabled.description: Append AI reasoning requests and decisions to the ai-audit log file

javaAstAnalyzer.documentationBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the RICA docs site. The violations webview opens `<base>/violations/<CODE>.html` when you click Docs on a violation row
